latest.headline: Asian chip rout points MU about 4% lower into Nvidia week
latest.tldr: Memory sold off hard across Asia (SK Hynix −7.89%, Kioxia −7.7%, Taiex −6.03%) and MU's last print was $744.00 (−4.41%) at 6:32 ET after Friday's $778.31 close, so expect a gap down of roughly 2.5% to 6.5% the day before Nvidia reports.
